"""Supplementary coverage observation of already fully compared native Gs.

Does not construct Expected, admit new graphs or confer proof authority.
"""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'tools'))
from oracle import production_input_graph as O
result=O.read('target/'+O.P+'input-g-oracle-results.json')
assert result['case_ids']==154 and result['missing']==result['unexpected']==result['uncompared']==0
m=O.catalogue();reg=m['structural_binding_registration'];b=O.Builder()
key=lambda v:json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
required={key(p['key']):p for p in reg['reference_policies'] if p['environment']=='g_value'}
assert len(required)==7 and all(p['domain']=='g_local' and p['profiles']==['raw_contract_validation'] for p in required.values())
names={(O.nominal(n)['owner'],O.nominal(n)['name']):n for n in b.bindings}
observed={k:[] for k in required};instances=0
for case in result['cases']:
 raw=(R/case['graph']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==case['actual_raw_sha256']
 graph=json.loads(raw)
 for rank,node in enumerate(graph['nodes']):
  parent,path,d=b.descriptor(names[(node['type']['owner'],node['type']['name'])])
  if d['kind']!='record':continue
  fields={r['field']:r['value'] for r in node['body']['record']}
  for field,ch in d['fields']:
   if ch.get('kind')!='dag_ref':continue
   identity=dict(parent=O.nominal(parent),path=[{k:v} for k,v in path+[['field',field]]]);token=key(identity)
   assert token in required and O.nominal(ch['target']['ref'])==required[token]['target']
   target=int(fields[field]);assert target<rank and graph['nodes'][target]['type']==required[token]['target']
   observed[token].append(dict(case_id=case['case_id'],parent_rank=rank,field=field,child_rank=target));instances+=1
assert all(observed.values()),[required[k] for k,v in observed.items() if not v]
rows=[dict(policy=required[k],native_edge_instances=observed[k]) for k in required]
out=dict(registered_policies=66,applicable_g_local_policies=7,executed_g_local_policies=7,remaining_w_output_other_profile_policies=59,compared_edge_instances=instances,missing=0,unexpected=0,rows=rows,remaining=[p for p in reg['reference_policies'] if p['environment']!='g_value'],basis='Supplementary observation only. Every input graph was first source-derived and fully typed-compared by the committed independent Oracle; remaining policy uses are not G inputs and receive zero production credit.',observer_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
raw=(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf8')
(R/'target'/(O.P+'policy-runtime-coverage.json')).write_bytes(raw)
(R/'docs/implementation'/(O.P+'policy-runtime-coverage.json')).write_bytes(raw)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['rows','remaining','observer_source']},indent=2))
